content: Ɓitɓa ñakɗa na ina a eɗoh.
A Yeesu woo po a jaɗtukka kotii, a hotta ɓi heɗ alal ɓekeeɗa kopor ca ɓa eɗoh wuu Kooh ŋ ɗiska na ɓekohse kopora ŋ Kahan Kooh.
A nammba hot ɓitiɓ ñakiɗ yi ƴaar ce kaan ; yeem ɓekeeɗa nga hanjar kanak ƴin findi pistiriñ.
Yeesu woosa ne : « Ñam na woyee ɗu wa te wa keeh, ini ɓitɓi ñakɗii eɗoh weɗ uup ciŋ ɓinooɓi jen.
Laam findi ɓa hend jen, ɓa eɗoh ini ɓa etohɗi ŋ raak-raakiŋ ɓa, waaye a yi, ŋ ñaki a ñak a eɗoh ini a raakee pesoha jen. »
In ci raakan
Ƴutta, ɓi ɓo' laaseeɗa Kahan Kooh moɗ sagu atoh ca moɗohngaan ca wa haɓɗohu na in ca na eɗohse wuu Kooh nga. Yeesu loffa ɓa ne :
« Ɗu hotiɗ in cii jen e ? Jamano hey haye ali atoh tasanɗi ŋ ɗafuk atoh ŋ ndii, ca jen ca hey yahrohse. »
Ɓa meekissa ɗe ne : « Jangɗohohi, in ceem na hee raake kiɗa ? Te wa ye na hee teeɓohe ne in ceem ca ɗi heeɗa raake ? »
Yeesu loffa ne : « Wortukaat muuƴɗu laam ɓo' laayiɗ hey haye, ɓa kooɗ tiikiŋ ngo ɓa woyee ne ɓeɗ Mucɗohi Gapohse, ɓa namee woo ne jamanooni reyiɗ ; kinaat ɓa taambiɗ ŋ ineem.
Kaɗ po ɗu kerah ɓi hiñoh yakak, wala ɗu kerah ɓi yoond ɗah, kinaat jaahiɗ ; in ceem joy joy raak paaɗ, waaye nikanɗi ne a Adina na reehe. »
Yeesu degga nga ne : « Kur hey hiñohe na kur morom wa, buur hey hiñohe na buur morom ce.
Kehƴi hey yoondɗuke keeh-keeh ŋ ɓi ɗisik laayiɗ te ŋ kur laayiɗ aɗ na kosaay ci kaɓkohan hey raake nga. Ɓi in tiitɗohiɗ hey raake ; te ŋ eel ci ɓi in feyohiɗ hey hotke nga.
Waaye bala in ceem raakan, ɗu hey ambse, ɗu torhiɗu, ɗu ɓayu ŋ sinaagog ci ne ɗu atte'u, ɗu rangu ŋ kaso ; ɗu ɓayu ŋ fiki ɓi buur na ɓi goornoor saguuso.
Ineem hey tahe po ɗu min ndo seede ŋ fikiiɓa.
Waaye ambaat inii ŋ haf ciŋ ɗu : Ɗu joyɗi feyu ŋ findi ɗu joy ngeloh.
Laam e mi onan ɗu liiɓohaaɗ moɗiɗ po ali ɓo' ŋ ɓi sang ɗu minanɗi ngel na ɗu.
Baab ciŋ ɗu, na yaay ciŋ ɗu, na taambɗoh ciŋ ɗu, na ɓaah ciŋ ɗu na nawleeciŋ ɗu ɓeɗ ambɗukan ɗu, raakiɗ sah ɓi na hee apse nga ɗu.
Ɓooɓi jen hey ɗu sange saguuso.
Waaye ɗu ñakanɗi sah findi uup ƴissuut ŋ haf ciŋ ɗu.
Ɗu amb ndengiɗ ɗah, ɗu hey rahse kipes kiŋ ɗu.
Ɗu hot ɓi hiñohoh laayiɗ ndeeriɗ Yerusalem ɗah, teemb ndeem inhaat ne ɗumbuukiŋ wa usisɗi.
Wa ree ɗah, ɓooɓi wa raakan ŋ Yudee, ɓa saandohaat ŋ tangooca, wa raak ɓa ŋ ɗooƴ Yerusalem ɗah, ɓa pulaat nga, ɓi waa hee raake ŋ bilaf fa, ɓa kanaat dokuk ŋ Yerusalem.
Ŋ mbeh ceem, Kooh hey wirnde ɓo' nu nga tumohaaɗ ciŋ ɗe laam in ci woyu ŋ Fiis ci Hooliɗ ci jen joy joy raak.
Mas ɓitiɓ ci na hee nike rook ŋ jamanooneem na ɓapɗoh ci ! Tiis miskiɗ hey raake ŋ kur ki, Kooh hey teeɓe ɓooɓi ayrukiŋ ɗe.
Ɓo' laayiɗ hey apse na ndang, ɓum tumu ñaam ŋ kur ci cinooci jen. Ɓooɓi nikɗi Yawuut hey daksohe Yerusalem po mbaɗna jamanooniŋ ɓa mitan.
Ɓi in hey hotke ŋ nohi, na caɓni na hor ci, te ŋ kehƴi, ɗuuɗiŋ cookmi na ginaah ciŋ wa hey feye ɓooɓi po ɓa inhissuu in ci ɓa haɓɗan.
Hatil ci nik ŋ eel ci hey yoondɗasse, ŋ ineem ɓooɓi hey liiɓe ŋ in ci raakan ŋ kehƴi, wa hey ɓa tahe reɓ kaan sagu tiit.
Teemb ndeem ɓa hey hote Kuɓkiŋ ɓoyi hayee ŋ eel, a hun na hatil, na yaki keeh-keehi a yak.
In ceem jen camb ɗah, jaɗtukaat, ɗu tufuk ; raakan faɗsuukiŋ ɗu reɓiɗ. »
Yeesu degga nga ne : « Markaat ndun mbaa kidig ci cinooci,
ca kifsee ɗah, ɗu na jaare inah ne rehi usisɗi ɗiski wa nik.
Wa mand ɗaa, ɗu nam hot in ceem ɗah, inhaat ne Nguuriŋ-Kooh usisɗi.
Ñam na woyee ɗu wa te wa keeh, ɓooɓiŋ adinaani woti kurkohanɗi nga jen te in ceem jen raakɗi.
Eel ci na kehƴi hey coote waaye woo ciŋ ngo moosanɗi cootoh.
Tumaat ndaangka, kinaat tum kipes kiŋ ɗu an na laar te kinaat apuk ŋ in ciŋ Adina mbaa mbeheem hey ɗu mbipe ;
wa hey mbipe ɓooɓiŋ kehƴi jen.
Kinaat neeh, genaat kiim Kooh, ɗu min raak hatil mucoha ŋ in ceem po Kuɓkiŋ ɓoyi hay ɗah, ɗu min tufuk ŋ fikiice. »
Ŋ mbeh ceem, noh reesa ɗah, Yeesu jangɗohee ŋ Kahnaŋ Kooh, waaye wek ree ɗah, a kaɗ nika ŋ tangoora na woyse Tangooraŋ-Oliiw-ca.
Ɓooɓa jen meeɗta kaɗ nga ɗe ŋ Kahnaŋ Kooh na ɓaaɓ-teel ne ɓa sikɗuk ɗe.
